notes.title: More Demo Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We updated the Okko The Exiled Demo... AGAIN! With just under a month left to play it, we wanted to polish up a few extra things. [/p][p]Worth noting– bigger updates/changes related to core gameplay, accessibility, etc., will not appear in the demo, as those updates will take longer and have broader effects on the development of the game. Meaning, if there are any more demo updates before the end of July, they'll also be small. [/p][p]The Patch Notes for this update are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Added new sound effects for the Mushroom Enemy. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation sync issue with the mercenaries in The Old Throne. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Gem Counter UI issue related to looting small gems right after looting a big gem. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Gem Counter UI issue where Okko's gem UI would not update properly after spending money at the shops. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay/UI bug combo that would allow Okko to buy potions even if he already had the max amount (2 of each) in his inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio bug that would cause Okko's "surface landing" sound to play when jumping up through one-way platforms. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the tutorial dialogue. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug related to "Gem Burn" sounds / gem counting not behaving properly when opening/closing the Inventory. notes.title: Demo Staying Up A Bit Longer
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! 

First off, thank you for making the "Okko The Exiled Demo" a huge success! The demo has been downloaded thousands of times and it's been played thousands of times as well! You're blowing our minds! Also, thanks for all the feedback via the game's Community Hub, email, and everywhere else you've reached out! [/p][p][b]The short of this post is that the demo has to come down at some point, but we're leaving it up a bit longer, so even more people have a chance to discover/play the game.[/b] [/p][p]Our data shows that a lot of people have downloaded the demo, but still haven't taken it for a spin. This could be for any number of reasons. Because of this, we're going to leave the demo "active" for a bit longer, and we'll do a post here and on Socials giving a heads up before it comes down. [/p][p]In case you're unaware, when the demo becomes inactive, you won't be able to launch it anymore, even if you've already downloaded it. [/p][p]Why remove the demo at all? Essentially, as we keep developing the game, addressing player feedback, polishing things up, adding new features, etc., the demo won't represent the full quality of the game. I don't think any developer wants an old demo representing their work at a certain point.[/p][p]All that said, we'll look into possibly releasing another demo closer to the game's launch. It'd be awesome to have a pre-launch Okko demo, where save data carries over to the full game. [/p][p]Thanks again for making Steam Next Fest such a huge success for Okko The Exiled! Thanks for the feedback, YouTube videos, Tweets, and all the ways you've shared the game with us and everyone else! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]– FFI Team[/p]

notes.title: Updated Combo Attack, New Sounds, And More
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! 

Happy Steam Next Fest Day 1! [/p][p][/p][p]We updated the Okko demo again, to improve combat a bit, add new sounds, and make some other tweaks as well.   Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Updated Okko's Combo and Launch Attack "Swing Effect" animations and collision boxes, to make combo-ing a bit easier. Now, the colliders on these attacks are roughly the same size/distance away from Okko's body as his normal attack is, making combos feel a bit better when judging attack distance from enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated Okko's Bounce-Attack animation. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated various sounds! You might notice new sounds for looting HP skulls/bones, potions, and a way more ominous sound when the guardian boss makes the bounce-skulls appear. (iykyk) [/p][/*][*][p]"NO" is now the first/top option when choosing to exit a level via a checkpoint. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Demo progress is NOT saved" disclaimer to the title screen after choosing Start Game. [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked a few tiles in a couple levels for better readability. [/p][/*][*][p]Added some gems to help guide the player "down" in a couple of levels where you have to use the one-way platforms to progress. [/p][/*][*][p]Made the mouse cursor invisible since the mouse is not used in the game. [/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for this update! Thanks as always, and if you've enjoyed the demo, don't forget to tell a friend or share it in some way. That helps us out sooOOOOoo much![/p][p]—FFI Team [/p]

notes.title: Audio Remix And Small Bug Fixes

notes.title: Controls Update and Small Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This is a small QOL update of sorts. 

The Patch Notes are as follows:

[list]
[*] Gamepad [Left Analogue Stick] now works for game menus. (Previously it only worked for Okko's movement). 
[*] When playing on a gamepad, [D*Pad Up] and/or [Left Analogue Stick Up] are now used to "Interact" with NPCs and the Checkpoints (when using the Checkpoints to access the World Map.) This is to further prevent players from accidentally firing off projectiles when interacting with those types of objects in the game world. 
[*] Added an extra Bounce-Skull to Level 2, to make one of the jumps easier. 
[*] Adjusted the height of a couple of moving platforms that hover above the water in Level 1, to prevent an audio bug that happened if Okko repeatedly scraped against the top of the moving platform. 
[*] Extended the ground in an early-ish part of Level 1 to make the jump more fair. (Prior to this update, you almost had to rely on "Coyote Time" to pull off the jump, which wasn't the intent.)
[/list]
That's all for this update!

Thanks as always!

— FFI Team

notes.title: Game Intro / Tutorials Skip + Unlock Demo Levels!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just patched the game again!

Here are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] From the Title Screen, after choosing "Start Game", you can now choose to Skip the Game Intro / Tutorials, and also choose to Unlock all the Demo Levels. 

[b]NOTE: [/b]If you do not choose to skip the Game Intro / Tutorials you will not be prompted to unlock all the demo levels. (We're assuming that if you want to go through the Intro / Tutorials, you want the full demo experience.)

[*] To Quit the game on PC you'll now have to hold "Q" and "Backspace" at the same time. This is to prevent players from accidentally quitting the game when playing on Keyboard. 
[/list]
We realize the lack of a Save Feature in the demo is kind of a bummer. The truth is we simply didn't have time to implement the save system for this demo. So, while being able to "unlock all levels" doesn't do anything to preserve the gems you've collected or the items you've found, at least you'll be able to hop back into action immediately.

Rest assured the final game will have a save system, which will include some form of auto-save. 

As always, thanks for the support, feedback, and thanks so much for checking out the game! 

— FFI Team

notes.title: Bounce-Attack Fix, Analogue Stick Movement, and More!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The "Bounce Attack Patch" is now live! 

Getting this patch live at the end of the weekend wasn't ideal, but thankfully there's still a lot of time left in June's Next Fest (which hasn't even officially started), and we didn't have to wait our entire "timeout" period because Valve got back to us in a decent amount of time and resolved the issue swiftly. 

All that said, definitely let us know if you find any more bugs/other issues with the game. We'll always take your feedback into consideration and do everything we can to improve the game as we get closer and closer to launch. 

Patch Notes: 
[list]
[*] Improved Bounce-Attack! You'll now initiate the bounce-attack by simply pressing Down on the D*Pad or Down on the Left Analogue Stick. The attack's animation is snappier too, which makes Okko's attack hitbox appear much sooner than before.
[*] Left Analogue Stick can now be used to control Okko's movement. For now, you'll still be using the D*Pad for the menus, but this update should alleviate some of that D*pad fatigue. 
[*] Fixed a bug where, when buying items from Mongravis, Okko's UI gem count wouldn't update when the player exited the shop. 
[*] Replaced the "$" symbol in Mongravis' shop with the proper gem icon. 
[*] Made it so now Okko can't fire Projectiles in The Old Throne, to prevent him from accidentally firing them off when talking to NPCs. (Theoretically this could still accidentally happen when talking to buried demons in the game world, so maybe we'll just map a different default button to "Interact" in the future.)
[*] Fixed some small audio bugs. 
[/list]

Thank you again for all the feedback, understanding that these things take time to iron out, and sticking around as we keep making the game best it can be! 

— FFI Team

notes.title: Bounce-Attack Update In Progress!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Thanks for all the feedback and thoughts regarding the "Okko The Exiled Demo"!

While a lot of people are enjoying their time in Kutala, one thing is clear: [b]Okko's "bounce-attack" still needs some work![/b]

After reading all the comments, we've realized the issue is big enough to warrant another demo update, as we want everyone's experience with the game to be as fun and fluid as possible. 

We know there are other features people really want as well, like key binding options, an analog stick option, and other QOL features, and we promise we'll get to those in the full game! But right now, the bounce-attack is  going to be our focus, as bouncing is such a core pillar of the gameplay and movement system. 

Thanks again for the feedback, support, and helping us make Okko's journey the best it can be!

— FFI Team

notes.title: Endless-Fall-Loop Bug Hot-Fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Small bug update:

We fixed a bug where Okko would sometimes enter an endless "falling" animation loop when bounce-attacking objects. He would stay in this animation even when touching the ground, and there was no way to exit the animation unless he got hit by an enemy. It was kind of a hot-fix, but it should do the trick for the demo. Thanks to everyone who reported it! 

We'll keep an eye on the "Bugs Discussion" on Steam and work towards fixing anything game-breaking that gets reported. 

Thanks again for checking out the demo and supporting the game! 

—FFI Team

notes.title: Okko The Exiled Demo Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With the “Okko The Exiled Demo” going live today, we wanted to take a minute to share our thoughts and plans regarding the project. 

First off, if you decided to check out the demo, Wishlisted the game, Followed us here or on any of the socials, thank you! 

This demo is exciting for us because it’s the first time we’re sharing what we’ve been working on with a wider audience! We’re hoping the demo gives you a glance at the spirit of the game, and also answers questions about how it plays, how it sounds, and how all its elements come together to form the whole experience. 

In case you didn’t know, on the development side of the game, we’re a passionate team of three. Essentially, we’re one programmer/level designer, one artist, and one sound designer/musician. Our goal with the game is to create an experience that’s super fun, memorable, heartfelt, and also satisfies fans of the 2D action genre, which includes ourselves. We want to take players on a twisting journey through the lands of Kutala, where they’ll be treated to jaw-dropping environments, epic boss battles, a deep story, sweeping musical score, and challenges aplenty. 

After playing the demo, feel free to give us feedback on where the game is at, and if you want, let us know if you find any bugs. We spent a lot of time polishing up the game for the demo, but there are still some rough edges here and there. For example, we totally acknowledge that sometimes the dialogue text gets too small. We’ll fix that in the full game’s release. You might also find some small collision bugs or other random stuff. We’ll iron that out too. Last but certainly not least, is the sound. The music tracks in the demo are 100% original and final, aside from small touches that could get tweaked down the line. However, the sound effects are only about 35% original and final. Meaning, the sound will only get better and better as we continue development, and continue to replace the debug/placeholder sounds. 

We still have a lot of work to complete as we keep pushing to get “Okko The Exiled” finished by the end of 2025! We hope you enjoy your time with the demo and we look forward to hearing your feedback. 


Thanks as always,

FFI Team

notes.title: Okko The Exiled's Next Fest Demo Is Complete!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

That's right, you read it in the headline— Okko's Next Fest demo is complete! 

As you might already know, the upcoming Steam Next Fest is taking place from June 9 - 16, and during this time the “Okko The Exiled Demo” will be available for download. 

This demo represents the first “chapter” of Okko’s journey, as he travels to The Old Throne, and then seeks out the Old Sabaoth Guardian. Based on our internal testing, the demo seems to be 45 - 60 minutes long! The idea here, is that this amount of time will give players (you!) a good idea of how the game plays, how it’s structured, and how insanely epic Okko’s story is going to be in the full game!

With the demo right on the horizon, we wanted to share some gameplay tips that should help you guide Okko through Kutala, as he carves a path of destruction to the demo’s conclusion. 

GAMEPLAY TIPS:
[olist]

[*]Use Okko’s heart! This means, get comfortable with Focus Mode, as it really changes the way you approach enemies and other obstacles. If any of the enemies in the game feel too “spongy”, try landing a critical hit on them. For example, the Fauns— those things have 4 HP. And to defeat them, Okko can either hit them 4 times (so spongy), or simply land one critical hit to defeat them instantly (not so spongy).

[*]Don’t be afraid to use Okko’s Projectile Resources (little energy stones that hover around Okko when he collects a Red Skull). Okko’s Dragon Wave (projectile attack) does huge damage to a row of enemies, and chances are there’s another Red Skull not too far ahead. The problem is, if Okko already has 3 Red Skulls, he won’t be able to loot a 4th, so you’ll have to either fire off a round for fun, or leave the newly-discovered Red Skull behind. 

[*]Revisit The Old Throne! There’re a couple of reasons to do this:

1) After going through a level or two, Okko might have enough Gems to buy something from the shops, or he might have found enough ingredients for PanPan to cook him a hot meal!

2) The NPCs at The Old Throne will have new things to say. There’s actually a ton of lore in the game, but it’s not really spoon-fed to the player. You gotta poke around. You gotta be curious. You gotta check out the scrolls you collect.

[*]Use potions in a pinch! When you loot a potion for the first time, check your inventory for a description of what it does. Currently, Okko can only hold 2 of each type of potion. These potions have various effects and can easily turn the tides of battle if Okko ends up in a tight spot.
[/olist]
That's about it for now. Sure, we could go on about linking attacks, using the bounce-smash, and other tactics, but we want to leave a bunch of stuff for players (YOU!) to discover on your own. 
 
We’re super excited to share the “Okko The Exiled Demo” with everyone in June and we hope you’ll check it out!

As always, thanks for your support and interest in the game! 

— FFI Team
